scope: preregistered before Package2 modeling; Package1 sources only
unknown_principal_share: report independently; do not hide cold names

distribution.otherwise: suppress distribution and signals; strictest gate wins; propagate unknown amount

flow.same_day_offset: confirm already included; never subtract twice
flow.netting: assumption only; also test same-day replacement sensitivity

vintage: append immutable source bodies and retrieval timestamps; current retrospective history is not original publication vintage; retain next-day revised previous balances separately
warmup: begin only after initial unknown lots <=10%; total matching does not validate per-security accuracy

early_checker.fixed_selection: large financing, high turnover, persistent initial inventory, corporate action, ordinary control; preregister names before modeling

margin_cap: both markets general maximum 60%; security/date reductions require evidence; not actual borrowing ratio
maintenance: financing-only market estimate; not whole-account actual collateral ratio; 130% diagnostic reference only
ETF: cap/dividend/leverage separate; inverse direction explicit; other products remain other; current rule labels not historical fund membership
corporate_actions: unadjusted price for debt reference; separate adjusted diagnostic or event markers; split/rights gaps block cost continuity
